lastMessage:
fix(api): reorder honeypot checks before validation

Move honeypot detection before safeParseBody to silently discard
spam bots without revealing validation schema. Also fix optional
chaining syntax for Vercel compatibility and add missing zod dep.

- contact.js: cf_website_url check before validation
- quote.js: mcc_valid_field check before validation
- book.js: hp_field check + replace ?. with &&
- Add zod ^3.25.76 to dependencies
- Remove accidentally committed deploy-output.txt
